input.summary: Add mutual uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality/data protection, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) to Section 9
input.comment: [Playbook] The mutual cap (greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges) works for us, but our position is that breaches of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP sit outside the cap. We have added a single mutual carve-out sentence rather than reopening Sections 9.1 and 9.2; if helpful, we can narrow it to indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement (including Sections 6, 9.1 and 9.2), the limitations of liability in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 do not apply to, and neither party's liability is limited in respect of: (a) a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations; (b) a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8; (c) a party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud; or (d) a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
